description.value: Established in 1991, Spirit Gallery is an Aboriginal-owned West Coast Native Art gallery located in Horseshoe Bay, steps from the waterfront of Howe Sound. It carries an extensive collection of carvings, jewellery, prints, and gifts from both renowned and emerging Indigenous artists. For cyclists riding the Sea to Sky corridor or catching the Horseshoe Bay ferry, the gallery is a distinctive cultural stop in a walkable village setting.
